column1: # content: the 4+4 model in its two forms: the vacuum of a field without mass term with the filled states of negative energy (cutoff Lambda = 1: all quantities in units of the cutoff)
column2: 2 per cent below and 2 per cent above the critical strength g_crit = G_c/(G_S^HF per unit strength)
column3: where G_c = -(2 pi)^D (D - 1)/(NU A_D Lambda^(D-1)) is the critical coupling. Above it the field acquires a mass by its own self-interaction: in the quantized-sector form the same mass in both halves (the mass term psibar psi of the positive Lagrangian)
column4: in the covariant form masses of opposite sign in the two halves (the mass term psitilde psi of the covariant Lagrangian)

column1: # columns: D; set; form; Gc: G_c Lambda^(D-1); g_crit; Mp_below
column2: Mm_below: masses of the two halves at 0.98 g_crit; Mp_above
column3: Mm_above: at 1.02 g_crit (the solution of lowest Omega; the solutions of lowest Omega are degenerate by the exchange of the halves and by the reversal of both signs: the representative with Mp_above > 0 is listed); n_solutions: number of solutions of the two gap equations of the vacuum at 1.02 g_crit
